string.text: SureFire's M600DF Scout Light is a rifle-mounted tactical light built around a hard-anodized aluminum body and a recoil-resistant TIR optic. Its sealed construction, compact Scout mounting pattern, and tailcap controls are designed for hard field use.

SureFire's M300C Mini Scout is a compact rifle-mounted tactical light with a hard-anodized aluminum body and recoil-resistant TIR optic. Its sealed housing, low-profile mount, and click-style tailcap package Scout Light construction into a lightweight form.

SureFire's X300U-B is a pistol-mounted tactical light with an aluminum body, sealed construction, and a recoil-resistant optic. It uses an ambidextrous momentary or constant-on switch and a screw-clamp rail mount intended to remain secure under repeated recoil.

SIG Sauer's compact FOXTROT1X pistol light uses a sealed 6061 aluminum housing and fits common pistol rails. Ambidextrous side switches support momentary or latched operation, while interchangeable rail keys adapt the unit to different handguns.

Olight's BALDR Pro combines a pistol-mounted tactical light with an adjustable green aiming laser in an aluminum housing. It uses ambidextrous controls, a quick-release mounting lever, and interchangeable Glock and Picatinny rail adapters.

Streamlight's TLR-1 HL is a pistol-mounted tactical light built with a machined aluminum body and sealed construction. Its rail-grip clamp can be secured without placing a hand in front of the muzzle, while ambidextrous controls provide momentary, constant, and programmable strobe operation.
